capture_source: live capture 2026-06-26 via Wireshark on enp111s0; SAP A4H sysnr=00 port=3300
evidence: NI write path; COM_HEAD confirmed at payload+80 after GW header
notes: First RFC message of a session — the only frame that contains COM_HEAD
COM_HEAD (D9C6C3F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0) = EBCDIC 'RFC000000000' (12 bytes) at payload offset 80
After COM_HEAD: logon TLV records (credentials, client, user, codepage, etc.)
Subsequent function call frames do NOT have COM_HEAD — TLV stream starts immediately after RFC_MARKER
This is NG-RFC format (vs classic CPI-C format which has a different header structure)
